description.narrative:
PLEASE REVIEW YOUR ANSWER AS THE QUESTION HAS BEEN CHANGED
Svenska ambassaden i Kampala avser att upphandla ett ramavtal för revisionstjänster med syfet att:
1) ge ambassaden möjlighet att upphandla olika typer av revisionstjänster 2) assistera ambassaden och samarbetspartners att bygga intern kapacitet vad gäller revision 3) att på en ad hoc bas assistera med frågor som uppkommer med kort varsel och som kan besvaras samma dag via mail eller telefon, d.v.s. en sorts lokal "help desk" vad gäller revisionsfrågor
Ramavtal ämnas tecknas med högst 3 parter under 120 timmar rankat och över 120 timmer förnyad konkurrensutsättning. Denna insats innehåller dels själva ramavtalet och dels utnyttjandet av ramavtalet, d.v.s. varje avrop blir en utbetalning under denna insats. Detta för att hålla ihop revisionstjänsterna och ha kontroll över hur mycket som avropas och till vad mm.

This contribution puts in place a framework for audit services through an open tender procurement process. The aim is: (1) to give the Embassy of Sweden in Uganda the possibility to undertake different types of auditing and related services including financial assurance and nonassurance audits and other audit related services (2) to assist the Embassy and counterpart institutions, authorities and organizations in building internal capacity relating to audit activities. (3) to assist on and adhoc basis in less complicated audit advice that can be given by telephone or email within a day
The agreement will be ranked for assignment up to 120 hours and renewed competition will be undertaken for all assignments above 120 hours. The ambition is to sign agreement with max 3 firms

This audit framework agreement was decided through using Trac. This has since changed, and there is no requirement to manage these kind of contributions in Trac, but rather throuh PlanIT and Klaradia/archive. Unfortunately when the archive structure was set up we were not aware of that each call off be registered as an individual case in Klaradia, and still linked to the same contribution. The physical archive has however been structured in folders according to the call offs made so that is is easy to locate documents: R01 - Nogamu R02 - audit help desk R03 - aBi budget R04 - financial follow up process R05 - UNHCO Forensic R06 - HIvos assessment R08 - SRHR Umbrella governance structure R09 - Makerere Budget R10 - UNCHO Forensic II R11 - Nogamu internal control R12 - Nogamu spot check R13 - Mak budget assistance R14 - Technoserve audit R15 - Reconciliation QUISP R16 - Makerere follow up audit R17 - Naguru financial reporting R18 - Nogamu audit R19 - International alert audit R20 - Hivos financial audit (interrupted) R21 - Muchap spot check R22 - HiiL seed funding CU01 - Diakonia internal mgmt and control CU02 - UNHCO financial audit CU03 - Hivos forensic CU04 - Diakonia FoF CU05 - Hivos financial audit
